newsitem.title: INDIA: India signs three contracts with Essar Oil.
newsitem.headline: India signs three contracts with Essar Oil.

text.p: The Indian government has signed production-sharing contracts for three oil and gas exploration blocks with Essar Oil Ltd, an official statement said on Wednesday.
The three exploration blocks awarded included, BB-OS/5 in Bombay offshore, RJ-ON-90/4 and RJ-ON-90/5 in the north-western state of Rajasthan under the fifth round of bidding, it said.
The state-controlled Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd is a signatory to the contract for the Bombay offshore block and Oil India Limited for the two blocks in Rajasthan.
"The centre has so far awarded contracts for 30 exploration blocks for the from fourth to eigth round of bidding for exploration of oil and gas," the statement said.
